//: The scripts are a composition root — `evaluate.ts`, `dev.ts` and `smoke.ts` are three of the
few files permitted to construct adapters — so this deliberately maps every package. It is
not an exception to the dependency rule; the rule constrains packages, and a composition
root is where the wiring is supposed to live.
It exists so `npm run typecheck` covers this directory. `scripts/typecheck.mjs` has always
looked for it; until now there was nothing to find, and the pre-commit and pre-push gates
were the only code in the repository that nothing checked.
